description: This PHP class 'Dependent' extends 'ListableDisplayField' and is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the reporting display fields related to dependent information. It defines methods to specify the associated Data Transfer Object class, entity aliases, and database fields used for report generation.

classes.name: Dependent
classes.description: Represents a display field for dependents in the HRM reporting module. Extends the ListableDisplayField class to provide specific DTO class, entity alias, and database fields related to employee dependents.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field, specifically 'Dependent'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides an array of entity aliases used in database queries, in this case ['dependent'].

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database field identifiers related to this display field, here 'employee.empNumber'.
